dict.string: Meeting Recorder records your microphone together with system audio.
Meeting Recorder records system audio so the other meeting participants are in the recording.
Meeting Recorder asks your browser for the address of the front tab, for the local activity log. Nothing leaves this Mac.
Meeting Recorder lets your iPhone read your meetings from this Mac over your local network when you turn on iPhone access. Nothing goes through a server.
Meeting Recorder transcribes your recordings on this Mac. Audio never leaves the device.
